heading: Rupee rises 5 paise to 95.82 against dollar on equity gains, easing oil
author: Edited by: Prisha Patnaik / TIMESOFINDIA.COM /  Sep 21, 2026, 11:07 IST
paragraphs: Prisha Patnaik is a journalist with The Times of India, writing across geopolitics, international affairs, culture, history and internet culture. With over two years of experience in social media and digital content, she is interested in how news, politics and culture are shaped for digital audiences. She holds a master’s degree in Media and Communications from Goldsmiths, University of London.
